newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Mining drops Bakun dam project.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Mining drops Bakun dam project.

text.p: Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd (MMC) has pulled out of a consortium developing the $5.5 billion Bakun hydroelectric power project, Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim confirmed on Tuesday.
Anwar said MMC's five percent stake in the dam holding company has been taken over by the government's investment arm Khazanah Holdings Bhd.
Speaking to reporters after opening an economic conference, Anwar said one reason MMC decided to give up its stake was because it was unable to gain more say in management of the project.
Last week, Ting Pek Khiing, executive chairman of Ekran Bhd, the main contractor of the dam, told reporters that MMC was giving up its stock in Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp.
The dam is in Sarawak state on the island of Borneo.

Anwar said on Tuesday that any party interested in taking over the stake previously held by MMC could negotiate with Khazanah, but added no party had so far approached the government concern on the issue.
The other shareholders of Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp are Ekran (32 percent), Tenaga Nasional Bhd (five percent) and Malaysia's national pension fund (five percent).
